preset.header: Are you ready for the tutorial?
preset.text: Once enough people click Ready, the tutorial will start!

If these were the cards played in a 4-player game, the player who played the Green 8 would win the trick.

The lead suit is Green (the suit of the first card) and the highest card in the lead suit is the Green 8.

If these were the cards played in a 4-player game, the player who played the Black 1 would win the trick.

The lead suit is Green (the suit of the first card) but the Black card trumps all the other suits.
... you become the first player for the next trick.
The 5 Escape cards rank lower than all the number cards.
The 2 Mermaid cards rank higher than all the number cards.
The 5 Pirate cards rank higher than all the number cards AND the Mermaids.
The 1 Anne Bonny card can be played as either an Escape or a Pirate card. Anne Bonny will split into 2 cards if it's in your hand, and you can play exactly 1 of them.
The 1 Blackbeard card ranks higher than all the number cards AND the Pirates, but loses to the Mermaid!
You will look at their cards at the start of the round and make a bid, which represents how many tricks you think you will win.

If your bid is greater than 0:
  • ... and you hit your bid exactly, you win 20 points per trick you bid.
  • ... and you DON'T hit your bid exactly, you lose 10 points per trick you were off.


    • If your bid is 0 (aka nil):
  • ... and you hit your bid exactly, you win 10 points per trick in the round.
  • ... and you DON'T hit your bid exactly, you lose 10 points per trick in the round.
An image of some skulls will be displayed in your video box. The number of skulls represents how many tricks you bid.
